title: excel-quality-metrics
pitch: Compute standard industrial quality KPIs from messy Excel exports with repeatable pipelines.
keyFeatures: Robust Excel ingestion (multi-sheets, merged headers, locale numbers/dates)
Prebuilt KPI functions (FPY, scrap rate, defect PPM, Pareto by cause)
Reproducible report outputs (cleaned dataset + KPI summary tables)
targetUsers: Manufacturing teams receiving Excel extracts from MES/ERP who need consistent defect, scrap, and yield KPIs.
